title: 职场与商务精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 这份报价包含售后支持，但不包含现场安装。
items.en: This quotation includes after-sales support but excludes on-site installation.
answers: This quotation includes after-sales support but excludes on-site installation.
items.notes: include 与 exclude 对照；quotation 在商务语境中指报价单。

items.zh: 你能把交付日期提前到周四吗？
items.en: Could you bring the delivery date forward to Thursday?
answers: Could you bring the delivery date forward to Thursday?
items.notes: bring ... forward 表示将时间提前；push ... back 表示推迟。

items.zh: 如果供应商今天不能确认，我们就需要启用备用方案。
items.en: If the supplier can't confirm today, we'll need to use our backup plan.
answers: If the supplier can't confirm today, we'll need to use our backup plan.
If the supplier cannot confirm today, we will need to use our backup plan.
items.notes: 真实条件句用 if + 现在时，主句 will；backup plan 指备用方案。

items.zh: 虽然销售额增长了，利润却因为运输成本上升而下降。
items.en: Although sales increased, profit fell because shipping costs rose.
answers: Although sales increased, profit fell because shipping costs rose.
items.notes: although 与 because 分别表达转折与原因；sales 和 profit 是不同指标。

items.zh: 我已经把客户的修改意见整理成清单，方便团队逐项处理。
items.en: I've organised the client's requested changes into a checklist so that the team can address them one by one.
answers: I've organised the client's requested changes into a checklist so that the team can address them one by one.
I have organised the client's requested changes into a checklist so that the team can address them one by one.
items.notes: organise ... into ... 表示整理成；so that 说明目的。

items.zh: 与其在邮件里来回讨论，我们不如约十五分钟把范围确认下来。
items.en: Rather than go back and forth by email, let's spend fifteen minutes agreeing on the scope.
answers: Rather than go back and forth by email, let's spend fifteen minutes agreeing on the scope.
items.notes: spend time doing；scope 指工作范围，agree on 表示就某事达成一致。

items.zh: 真正耽误进度的是审批时间，而不是设计工作本身。
items.en: What is delaying progress is the approval process, not the design work itself.
answers: What is delaying progress is the approval process, not the design work itself.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；itself 强调工作本身。

items.zh: 会议结束前，请确认每项任务由谁负责。
items.en: Before the meeting ends, please confirm who is responsible for each task.
answers: Before the meeting ends, please confirm who is responsible for each task.
items.notes: who 从句作 confirm 的宾语；be responsible for 表示负责。

items.zh: 这个客户要求的功能不在原合同范围内。
items.en: The feature this client requested falls outside the original contract.
answers: The feature this client requested falls outside the original contract.
items.notes: 省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 feature；fall outside 表示不属于某范围。

items.zh: 如果我们当时早点核对库存，就能避免承诺无法按时交付的数量。
items.en: If we'd checked stock earlier, we could have avoided promising quantities we couldn't deliver on time.
answers: If we'd checked stock earlier, we could have avoided promising quantities we couldn't deliver on time.
If we'd checked stock earlier, we could have avoided promising quantities we could not deliver on time.
items.notes: 过去虚拟条件句；avoid 后接 doing，quantities 后是省略关系代词的定语从句。

items.zh: 为了便于比较，请按相同的口径列出各方案的成本。
items.en: To make comparison easier, please present the costs of each option on the same basis.
answers: To make comparison easier, please present the costs of each option on the same basis.
items.notes: to do 说明目的；on the same basis 表示按同一口径。

items.zh: 只要质量检查通过，我就可以批准发货。
items.en: I can authorise dispatch as long as the goods pass the quality check.
answers: I can authorise dispatch as long as the goods pass the quality check.
items.notes: as long as 引出条件；authorise dispatch 表示批准发货。

items.zh: 这封邮件需要抄送财务部门吗？
items.en: Should the finance department be copied into this email?
answers: Should the finance department be copied into this email?
items.notes: copy sb into an email：抄送。

items.zh: 我已经把会议记录发给所有参会者了。
items.en: I have sent the minutes to everyone who attended the meeting.
answers: I have sent the minutes to everyone who attended the meeting.
I've sent the minutes to everyone who attended the meeting.

items.zh: 请在回复里注明您使用的是哪一版报价。
items.en: Please specify which version of the quotation you are using in your reply.
answers: Please specify which version of the quotation you are using in your reply.

items.zh: 在预算获批之前，我们不能承诺采购。
items.en: We cannot commit to the purchase until the budget is approved.
answers: We cannot commit to the purchase until the budget is approved.
We can't commit to the purchase until the budget is approved.

items.zh: 这个任务看似简单，但需要两个部门共同确认。
items.en: The task looks straightforward but requires confirmation from two departments.
answers: The task looks straightforward but requires confirmation from two departments.

items.zh: 我明天休假，紧急事项请联系我的同事。
items.en: I am on leave tomorrow; please contact my colleague about urgent matters.
answers: I am on leave tomorrow; please contact my colleague about urgent matters.
I'm on leave tomorrow; please contact my colleague about urgent matters.

items.zh: 能否在报告里分别列出已确认和预计的收入？
items.en: Could you list confirmed and projected revenue separately in the report?
answers: Could you list confirmed and projected revenue separately in the report?

items.zh: 我们需要知道延误是否会影响最终交付。
items.en: We need to know whether the delay will affect final delivery.
answers: We need to know whether the delay will affect final delivery.

items.zh: 客户要求的变更应先评估成本，再决定是否接受。
items.en: The client's requested change should be costed before we decide whether to accept it.
answers: The client's requested change should be costed before we decide whether to accept it.
items.notes: cost 作动词表示估算费用。

items.zh: 这项工作不在我的职责范围内，但我可以帮你找到负责人。
items.en: This falls outside my responsibilities, but I can help you find the person in charge.
answers: This falls outside my responsibilities, but I can help you find the person in charge.

items.zh: 我们需要一个明确的验收标准，以免交付时产生分歧。
items.en: We need clear acceptance criteria to avoid disagreements at handover.
answers: We need clear acceptance criteria to avoid disagreements at handover.

items.zh: 能否把讨论移到下午，让技术同事也能参加？
items.en: Could we move the discussion to the afternoon so that our technical colleagues can join?
answers: Could we move the discussion to the afternoon so that our technical colleagues can join?
items.notes: so that 说明改时间的目的。

items.zh: 这家供应商的价格较低，但付款条件更严格。
items.en: This supplier offers a lower price but stricter payment terms.
answers: This supplier offers a lower price but stricter payment terms.

items.zh: 我想先确认订单数量，再让团队开始准备。
items.en: I would like to confirm the order quantity before the team begins preparation.
answers: I would like to confirm the order quantity before the team begins preparation.
I'd like to confirm the order quantity before the team begins preparation.

items.zh: 这个数字包括税费吗？
items.en: Does this figure include taxes and charges?
answers: Does this figure include taxes and charges?

items.zh: 我已标出需要您批准的部分。
items.en: I have marked the sections that require your approval.
answers: I have marked the sections that require your approval.
I've marked the sections that require your approval.

items.zh: 我们今天能决定的，只是先开展小范围试行。
items.en: All we can decide today is to begin a limited trial.
answers: All we can decide today is to begin a limited trial.
items.notes: all ... is ...：限定当前决定范围。

items.zh: 会议拖得太久，留给行动安排的时间不够了。
items.en: The meeting ran over, leaving too little time to agree on next steps.
answers: The meeting ran over, leaving too little time to agree on next steps.

items.zh: 如果数据今晚到不了，我会在报告中标明尚未核实。
items.en: If the data do not arrive tonight, I will mark them as unverified in the report.
answers: If the data do not arrive tonight, I will mark them as unverified in the report.
If the data don't arrive tonight, I'll mark them as unverified in the report.
items.notes: mark A as B：标记为某状态。

items.zh: 新的流程减少了一次审批，却增加了前期准备工作。
items.en: The new process removes one approval stage but adds more preparation at the start.
answers: The new process removes one approval stage but adds more preparation at the start.

items.zh: 在最终签字之前，法务团队还需要检查条款。
items.en: The legal team still needs to review the terms before final sign-off.
answers: The legal team still needs to review the terms before final sign-off.

items.zh: 我可以负责执行，但优先顺序需要由项目负责人决定。
items.en: I can handle implementation, but the project lead needs to set the priorities.
answers: I can handle implementation, but the project lead needs to set the priorities.

items.zh: 客户没有回复，不一定意味着他们接受了方案。
items.en: A lack of response from the client does not necessarily mean acceptance.
answers: A lack of response from the client does not necessarily mean acceptance.
A lack of response from the client doesn't necessarily mean acceptance.

items.zh: 请保留修改记录，方便我们以后追溯决定。
items.en: Please retain the change history so that we can trace decisions later.
answers: Please retain the change history so that we can trace decisions later.
